integrity: Exact rational/integer computations and reproducible source code; no claim of external certification.
scientific_limitations: Conditional Frobenius-class classification of smooth degree-four del Pezzo surfaces; does not assert all 18 classes over a fixed field or independent verification. Existing Weyl actions and geometric cones are inputs. Equivalent tables may already exist.
title: Integral line-orbit saturation and arithmetic cones of quartic del Pezzo surfaces
